results.title: 7 Best Splitwise Alternatives for Splitting Bills
results.content: Splitwise now limits free users to a few expenses a day. Alternatives: Tricount (free, no daily limit), Settle Up (group expenses with offline mode), Splid (no sign-up needed) and Splitkaro, built for India with UPI settle-up.

results.title: Tricount - Split & settle bills with friends
results.content: Tricount is the easiest way to share group expenses with friends on trips, in flatshares and for couples. Free and without ads.

results.title: tricount: Split & Settle Bills - Apps on Google Play
results.content: Organise group expenses: tricount does the maths and tells who owes whom.

results.title: Settle Up - Group Expenses
results.content: Settle Up keeps track of your gang's expenses and shows who should pay next. Works offline, supports multiple currencies.

results.title: Splitkaro: split bills and settle with UPI
results.content: Splitkaro is an Indian bill splitting app for flatmates and trips. Settle up over UPI in one tap.

results.title: YNAB. Personal budgeting software for Type-A people
results.content: YNAB is a personal budgeting app that helps you give every dollar a job.
